runtime.build_strategy: single pinned CUDA server base plus Python standard-library gateway

llama_cpp_pin.pin_verification: official tag/digest recorded; target build must record --version and re-check digest

reranker.reason: No certified Querit artifact or llama.cpp-compatible interface; /v1/rerank returns MODEL_UNAVAILABLE

health.live: gateway process only; GET /health/live does not imply model readiness
health.ready: bounded embedding (2048 finite vector) and generator (non-empty final response) smokes; optional reranker is reported separately
health.startup: entrypoint waits for upstream /health then gateway /health/ready and exits on timeout

readiness.think_safety: balanced reasoning blocks are stripped; malformed reasoning fails closed

auth.mechanism: optional INFERENCE_API_TOKEN with Authorization: Bearer token on /v1/*

build_validation.reason: Current workstation is not the target A100 and pulling the CUDA base is unnecessary for static package validation
build_validation.gateway_unit_tests: PASS: 5 unittest cases with fake upstream servers
build_validation.shell_syntax: PASS: bash -n on entrypoint, verify-models and smoke scripts

medium_findings.finding: The official CUDA image tag/digest is pinned, but llama-server --version and flag support can only be confirmed on the target image.
medium_findings.mitigation: Entrypoint checks --help before launch; record --version during target build and smoke.

medium_findings.finding: Python is installed from the pinned CUDA image's Ubuntu package repository during image build; package snapshot is not separately pinned.
medium_findings.mitigation: Capture and deploy the final immutable image digest from Artifact Registry; tighten apt snapshot pinning if Cloud policy requires it.

low_findings.finding: No local image size or CUDA execution measurement was produced by design.
low_findings.mitigation: Measure on the Cloud.ru A100 target after push.
